name: lw_54762
statement: (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) : x^y + y^z + z^x ≤ x^x + y^y + z^z
closed: ∀ (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z), x^y + y^z + z^x ≤ x^x + y^y + z^z
informal: Prove the inequality $x^y+y^z+z^x{\leq}x^x+y^y+z^z$ for all positive numbers $x, y, z$.
